import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"elixir\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("IO.puts(\"hello\")", config)
